steps.content: The export covers July–September 2026. I’ll use the daily charge date for the two calendar-month totals, include all charge categories as requested, and handle any resource absent in either month as zero spend for that month.

tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
df['ChargePeriodStart'] = pd.to_datetime(df['ChargePeriodStart'])
df['BilledCost'] = pd.to_numeric(df['BilledCost'])
df['month'] = df['ChargePeriodStart'].dt.to_period('M')
months = df[df['month'].isin([pd.Period('2026-08'), pd.Period('2026-09')])]
monthly = months.pivot_table(index='ResourceId', columns='month', values='BilledCost', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
for month in [pd.Period('2026-08'), pd.Period('2026-09')]:
    if month not in monthly:
        monthly[month] = 0.0
monthly['increase'] = monthly[pd.Period('2026-09')] - monthly[pd.Period('2026-08')]
result = monthly.sort_values('increase', ascending=False)
print(result.head(10).to_string())
print('\nMonth totals:')
print(months.groupby('month')['BilledCost'].sum())
print('\nDistinct resources:', len(monthly))
print('Duplicate resource-date rows possible; all included.')
print('\nWinner exact values:')
winner = result.index[0]
print(repr(winner), repr(result.iloc[0]['increase']), round(result.iloc[0]['increase'], 2))
